reserveReview.compositionBasis: Standing whole-token claim identity corroborated by exact deployed code and pinned chain state; not a measured look-through allocation
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current strategy holdings, encumbrances, USDC/USDT mix and complete matched share-liability valuation are not established by the reviewed product documentation or deployment reads.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Exact whole-token claim is identified, but no reconciled constituent allocation is available; denomination is not a reserve weighting.
